preconditions.description: The length of str1 is between 1 and 100.
The length of str2 is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '*@#' for c in str1)
preconditions.description: Each character in str1 is one of '*', '@', or '#'.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '*@#' for c in str2)
preconditions.description: Each character in str2 is one of '*', '@', or '#'.

postconditions.expression: output == max(sum(1 for j in range(len(str2)) if str1[i] == str2[j]) for i in range(len(str1)))
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum number of bridges that can be built between the two strings, where a bridge is built between two similar trees in the same position of the strings.
